title: Great Pyramid built over hundreds of years, not in Khufu's 23-year reign

tellings.quote: More likely it's a it's a project that took hundreds of years to complete uh

plain: A writer on ancient history named Graham Hancock, talking in 2024 with podcast host Jesse Michels, says the Great Pyramid at Giza was most likely a project that took hundreds of years to finish. That goes against the usual view that it was built during the 23-year reign of Khufu, the Egyptian king it is credited to, and Hancock draws on the work of another author, Robert Bauval. If true, the pyramid's beginnings would reach back far earlier than the standard story allows.
